[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-1813.2589→-1813.2589) + holding steady + no trend reversal signal

· Swing resistance level (KRW 89,580) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional trend
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) + conditions for entry/wait-and-see: RSI recovery above 45 and increased volume confirmation
